name: brand_kit_add_document
description: Register brand-kit docs from a creation (source {kind: creation}), a temporal upload, or an in-app chat attachment. Returns doc ids; process PDFs/text with brand_kit_process_document. @see guides_get('brand-kit')

documents.description: 1–10 documents to attach. Each entry must supply exactly one of storage_url or source.

source.description: Reference to an existing creation. Mutually exclusive with storage_url.

identifier.description: Id of the chat file or the creation.

kind.description: creation — a Magnific image creation, e.g. one imported with creations_upload_image. agent_asset is only available inside the app.

storage_url.description: Temporal path from the upload endpoint (temp-files/<uuid>.<ext>; an .svg is type image). Mutually exclusive with source.
